question: Can a coordinate-fixed zero-sum 2x2 Gaussian source suppress low-frequency single-realization drift before the unchanged P4AF Gamma marginal without creating periodic, anisotropic or severe artifacts?

model.source_field: four independent coordinate-counter normals per aligned 2x2 block, block mean removed, multiplied by sqrt(4/3)

negative_controls: unchanged P4AF coordinate-counter correlated Gaussian copula

branch_rule.pass: Retain only as a generic synthetic low-frequency-controlled structure candidate and open an independently seeded severe/NPS confirmation before any photographic use.
branch_rule.fail: Close without block-size, sigma, seed, marginal, spectrum or threshold rescue; continue another physical or colour mechanism.

forbidden: using sample/image statistics to recenter the field
changing P4AF amplitude, marginal or sensitometry
photographic rendering, visual promotion or product integration
stock, process, scanner, grain-size or calibration claims
claim_ceiling: Generic synthetic Gaussian-copula variance-reduction experiment for the existing uncalibrated P4AF marginal; not physical emulsion geometry, measured film NPS, stock response, photographic quality or product evidence.
